cards.title: Absolute vs. Apparent PK Parameters
cards.claim: For extravascular (oral) administration, Clearance and Volume of Distribution are reported as apparent parameters (CL/F, Vz/F) because the fraction of dose absorbed (F) cannot be estimated from plasma data alone. Absolute CL and Vz are only computed for IV Bolus or Infusion models.
limitations: Apparent parameters (CL/F, Vz/F) are not directly comparable to absolute IV parameters without knowing F.
Vss is not computed for extravascular models because MRTINF includes mean input time.
cards.downstream_use: Correct interpretation of PK parameters for translation; avoiding direct comparison of oral CL/F with IV CL.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
